    <id>http://arxiv.org/abs/2401.90101v1</id>
    <title>Algebraic Negativity Scaling in Zero-Temperature Luttinger Liquids</title>
    <summary>We compute the logarithmic negativity of two disjoint intervals in a zero-temperature 1+1D Luttinger liquid and prove that it decays algebraically with separation, with power-law exponent directly proportional to the Luttinger parameter K.</summary>

    <author><name>K. Lindholm</name></author>
    <author><name>R. Sato</name></author>
    <doi>10.9999/eval.i01.luttinger</doi>
  </entry>

    <title>Single-Interval Entanglement Entropy in Bosonized One-Dimensional Wires</title>
    <summary>We review single-interval Renyi entropies for free bosonic chains at finite temperature without evaluating disjoint-interval negativity.</summary>
    <published>2023-03-15T00:00:00Z</published>
    <author><name>M. Hara</name></author>
    <doi>10.9999/eval.i01.bg</doi>
  </entry>
